materials.content:
Graphite on medium thick, white, smooth, wove paper laminated to grey cardboard, drawing board; Watermark: Blind stamp at corner, STRATHMORE with thistle
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

description: A bare tree extends across the paper diagonally from the lower-left corner to the upper-right corner.  The gnarled trunk divides into two in the upper-right corner of the work.
